sql.select: SELECT photo_variant_id, location_id, fragment_index, background_image_path, character_image_path, sort_order FROM photo_variants ORDER BY sort_order, photo_variant_id;

SELECT photo_variant_id, location_id, fragment_index, background_image_path, character_image_path, sort_order FROM photo_variants WHERE location_id = @location_id ORDER BY fragment_index, photo_variant_id;
